results.portable_execution: Initial104 passed; one dynamic-import packaging failure retained. Added the missing public dependency closure and reran only that affected guard, which passed. No unchanged104 replay.

closed_substantive_findings.finding: Nearest local endpoint projections may expand a cut and close a smaller positive exact gap while passing selected-span-relative tolerance. Earlier never-expanded wording did not describe the projected support correctly.
closed_substantive_findings.resolution: Module description and manifest now explicitly disclose endpoint movement/tiny-gap closure, prohibit projected overlap and manual repair, and distinguish geometric tolerance from a source-mass or physical-timing bound.
closed_substantive_findings.verification: One new coordinate probe and read-only final wording inspection; author added a focused regression. The twelve already-passing oracle cases were not rerun for a doc/metadata change.

review_conclusions: Exact rational intersections cover every positive part of supported disjoint source windows without truncation or dropping.
Output preserves caller window identity/order and chronological original interval association within each window.
Local endpoint/duration errors are relative to positive intersection support, not a large absolute epoch or parent duration.
Rounded canonical parent-duration error is always reported and qualified against the selected span only when its boundary is selected.
Shared exact cuts within one original interval project consistently; collapsed or unsupported positive spans reject without repair.
Exact rational and underflow diagnostics retain nonzero errors smaller than float64 projections.
Accepted geometric projection may erase a tiny gap; it is not exact support preservation or a release-law mass qualification.
limits: Coordinate-only independent review and thirteen new bounded cases; no physical source, gap, collision, radiation, spectra or experimental validation.
Global inputs denote supplied binary64 endpoints; no unrecoverable higher-precision experimental timestamp is inferred.
Source-emission restrictions are distinct from photon observation gates.
The exact reviewed code pin is authoritative; any later code change needs a scoped review update.

cli_review.scope: Independent read-only review of the preserved-history source-window comparison command, its documentation, and source-window-plan associations. No public edits, source evolution, older suites, or earlier oracle replay.

qualified_findings.subject: Eager package initialization is outside CODE_PATHS
qualified_findings.finding: The direct numerical import closure is covered, but importing the mhdlab package also executes mhdlab/__init__.py and its legacy import closure, which are not hashed by this command. The exact list is retained in review_probe.json. These eager legacy imports do not participate in the reviewed moment formulas, so this is not evidence of a numerical error in the current results.
qualified_findings.recommendation: Treat CODE_PATHS as selected numerical implementation pins, rather than the whole executed import environment. Retain the separately labelled portable empty-initializer wrapper or whole-repository association with study evidence. This accepted limitation does not require mutation of the running study.

assessments.state_status_hash_associations: Case source and evidence bytes are independently SHA256-bound; evidence must match source hash, status, exact parameter provenance, resolution and the explicit no-re-evolution flag. Canonical pool records retain state identities. Compared pools and provenance must be equal. Surface metadata must be equal except the two separately validated original/equivalent counts in the snapshot_common_intervals family or the canonical geometry-derived current_patch_intervals_m list in the current family. Status and ancestral-drive declarations remain supplied provenance rather than independently established physical facts, as documented.
assessments.fixed_order_comparisons: Source differences pair the same requested quadrature order for each source and window. Quadrature changes are reported separately as refined minus coarse within a single conditioned source. Source comparisons are estimate minus finer reference. No convergence order or uncertainty bound is inferred.
assessments.time_anchors: The comparison reconstructs each represented mean from its retained interval origin, window-start offset and conditional local mean using Fraction arithmetic before subtraction. It skips raw mean offsets with unlike anchors. Focused probes retained a -0.25 difference when both displayed absolute means rounded to 1e16, and obtained exact zero for equal physical means carried by unequal local anchors.
assessments.common512_snapshot_family: The family requires an increased snapshot count, identical width/current counts, equal snapshot-times-subdivision products, and identical actual source time edges. The current preserved configuration has four totals of512, with subdivisions64/32/16/8 compensating snapshots8/16/32/64. Optional followup_common_grid_resampling records require exactly seven keys; the original/equivalent counts match each case, actual integration matches source interval count with one subdivision, transformation flags must both beFalse, and original snapshot attributes remain a Mapping. Only the two separately checked original/equivalent counts are removed before cross-case metadata equality. Counts and shared domains do not independently certify the common physical drive, and the documentation states this limitation.
assessments.positive_population_retention: Every positive canonical initial component is conditioned; exact-zero initial inventory is explicitly recorded as a skip. Joint moments reject unqualified, missing, nonpositive, or exact-zero extensive released_number records for positive components. The command does not introduce a count floor or discard unrepresentable positive populations. An entirely empty source reports zero count and unavailable normalized moments.
assessments.energy_pathways: Thermal launch statistics use the outward-flux Maxwellian mean2kBT, variance2(kBT)^2, and associated second moments. The source-window record retains separate translation, supplied internal excitation, and desorption costs, excluding the activation barrier from wall debit. The CLI does not require every extensive wall-energy diagnostic to be qualified before reporting normalized source moments; qualification flags remain in each retained conditioned-source manifest, and host_budget_accepted is false. Thus the output is not an accepted wall-energy transaction or complete molecular-energy model.
assessments.source_window_plan: The reviewed API requires disjoint fully supported global windows, records exact represented-Fraction intersections and rounded local selections, rejects unsupported positive slivers and projected overlaps, and replays immutable associations. The documentation appropriately distinguishes coordinate tolerance from physical source-mass or timing uncertainty.
assessments.final_current_metadata_exception: The final four-line change removes only top-level current_patch_intervals_m from equality for the current family. Canonical TemkinPlanarReleaseHistory validation independently checks this list exactly against each history's z_edges_m, so this exception admits legitimate changed partitions without weakening unrelated physical metadata. Nested physical extraction/remapping associations remain strictly compared and require their own qualified transformation for comparisons that change them; no blanket nested exception was introduced.
assessments.final_documentation: The final documentation discloses accepted endpoint motion and tiny-gap closure, strict common-grid count/flag checks, the narrow current-derived-field exception, and selected numerical CODE_PATHS versus eager legacy imports and the labelled empty-initializer portable subset. These statements agree with the reviewed implementation.

review_conclusions: Represented individually qualified parent counts and translational energies are reduced as extensive amounts, then divided once by exact actual dx times full original current length.
Declared original float scalar patch area is distinct from exact endpoint geometry; signed declared-minus-geometry and extensive-minus-density-times-declared-area residuals are retained.
Matched uniform-width profiles are the linear marginal of redistributing each original conditioned component count and source translation by dx/fullwidth, preserving the other mixture coordinates.
Conditional expected translation is summed qualified source translation divided by summed represented count, with its source2kBT rounding residual retained.
Displayed density integral residuals match the represented extensive targets; matched count and translation sums close exactly without repair.
All highest-order stored paired controls match the original JSON; non-width invariants are exact and width descriptors are numerical source controls only.
Source-resolution changes, moment quadrature changes, and CSV display projections remain distinct evidence families.
profile_review.ledger_scope: Released parent count and expected translational source energy only. Internal-state/removal/full-wall ledgers remain in the conditioned source manifests and are not reduced or claimed as full profile closure.
profile_review.superseded_initial_artifacts: Formatting-only first export is retained under artifacts-initial; use artifacts for final numeric CSVs.
limits: Saved manufactured source artifact arithmetic/readback, not a new physical source or solver run.
No spectral, transport, chemistry, trajectory, statistical significance, material calibration or experimental claim follows from the profile differences.
Expected translation is neither a velocity realization nor an internal rovibrational energy partition.
Figures are hashed in this review; visual inspection belongs to root.
Completion applies to exact reviewed code/artifact hashes.
